contract: A23-69 stage 2 (stat_points §2, §3-3, §5-2, §6), switch Features.StatPoints OFF in Config: while off StatService writes nothing and refuses StatAction, the numbers are today's. On: attributes StatAtk / StatHp / StatFree / AutoStat = Config.StatAlloc(data.Stats, level, class) at PlayerReady, LeveledUp, LevelReset, Rebirthed, ClassChanged and after actions. StatAction(op, arg): add A|H, add5 A|H (min 5 free), reset (3 s), auto true|false (off copies the placed letters, on clears Order); add / add5 / reset need Auto off; refused in PvP combat / as a kaiju / with the grudge sack (TravelBlockedCombat / BlockedKaiju / BlockedSack), silently when dead, not ready, rate-limited (0.15 s) or with bad args. After a change RefreshCharacter(p, false) and 'Power X -> Y'; lines after the first [Claim]: the first point once, Auto level-up '+N Stat · Power X -> Y', by hand '+N Stat Point(s)! Tap Power.', the first Auto-off hint once; Fx Stat. Monster hits x (1 + f(Attack)); PvP ratio (aW x atk) / (vW x hp) clamped 0.8 (bare 0.4) - 1.5, base StatMaxHealth x 0.1: 6.67-12.5 hits; max HP = StatMaxHealth x Justice; the bait rule uses StatMaxHealth.
limitations: RefreshCharacter is a recording double (its HP-ratio rule is PlayerService.applyStats, unchanged); the [Stats] tab, the red dot and the chip glow are game dev 1's client (StatUI). The world's Justice multipliers are doubles (1).
